newsitem.title: USA: MGIC takes on Mortgage Guaranty risk.
newsitem.headline: MGIC takes on Mortgage Guaranty risk.

text.p: MGIC Investment Corp said on Monday that its Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Corp subsidiary (MGIC) has signed an agreement to assume the reinsurance on about $4.2 billion of Wisconsin Mortgage Assurance Corp's insurance in force.
The amount represents about $1.1 billion of risk in force written through February 28, 1985, MGIC said.
Wisconsin Mortgage Assurance wrote mortgage insurance on first mortgages collateralized by one-to-four-family residences.
MGIC said it will get about $40 million as payment for assuming the existing loss and unearned premium reserves related to the insurance in force it is assuming.

It said as a result of the transaction, the amount of Wisconsin Mortgage's insurance in force ceded to MGIC will increase to about $6.2 billion (representing about $1.6 billion of risk in force). The portion of Wisconsin Mortgage's insurance in force reinsured by MGIC will rise to about 65 percent from about 21 percent.
